summary: Conditional audit extract: tenant-mapped field provenance + resumable watermark manifest
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a one-time and resumable audit extract for a 90-day window scoped to specific tenant IDs with field-level provenance and a reversible pseudonymization mapping for legal review. Impact: FinLedger needs signed evidence for a regulatory data request and a playbook to verify redaction rules and mapping provenance. Request details: 1) Deliver hourly delta files (parquet) containing only events for tenant_ids in the provided map. 2) Each row must include a provenance column (source_system) that indicates whether the field originated in API-GW, Serving Runtime, or Console. 3) Provide a per-file manifest with HMAC-SHA256 checksums and a resume watermark token so the customer can resume interrupted transfers. 4) Include a pseudonymization map for actor_identity: reversible HSM-backed wrap for legal review, plus a separate irreversible-derivative for SIEM ingestion. 5) Provide a short playbook (steps + verification queries) for FinLedger SOC to validate redaction and integrity. Preferred delivery: SFTP push to customer-managed endpoint with signed manifest, and a short md5-of-manifest proof delivered via secure email. Deadline: Regulatory deadline in 7 business days from request date. Contact: FinLedger security lead (jen.hart@finledger.com) and Redwood account SE (Aisha Patel).

investigation_notes: Checked existing delta export pipeline: supports hourly deltas with resume tokens; will reuse but must insert provenance enrichment step post-raw-serialization.

Provenance source determined by event ingestion pipeline tags: api-gw events include header x-source=api-gateway; serving runtime emits runtime.origin=serving-runtime; console UI events emit user.action origin. Need unified mapping table to normalize values.

Pseudonymization approach: two artifacts required - (A) reversible wrap using HSM (requires INT key grant and audit log export), (B) irreversible salted hash for SIEM. Engineering preference: produce both columns actor_pseud_rev and actor_pseud_hash per row.

SFTP push mechanism: support-runbook exists at confluence page. File naming convention proposed: finledger/2026-03-10/2026-03-10T10:00Z.delta.parquet and manifest: finledger/2026-03-10/manifest-2026-03-10T10:00Z.json with hmac field.

Resume token design: 128-bit base64 token containing last-processed-event-id + utf8 timestamp, signed by export-service key. Export-service can accept resume token to skip previously-delivered events.
Dependencies: HSM key provisioning (INT-330), security attestation from Legal, SFTP acceptance test from FinLedger.
resolution: Workaround / next steps: SRE to schedule an initial acceptance test SFTP push of a 3-hour delta sample by 2026-03-13. If acceptance succeeds, run full 90-day window as a sequence of hourly deltas and push manifests. Long-term fix: add a generic provenance enrichment stage to delta pipeline and an export template for reversible/irreversible pseudonymization. Follow-ups: INT-330 for HSM key grant, and create a short runbook for SOC verification (confluence link in related_confluence_pages). Pending legal attestation before delivering reversible mapping.
